blocks.text: Galápagos: multicoloured volcanic slopes between coastal bays

Early in the morning, take a bus to the Itabaca Channel.

There, the group boards a yacht.

The crossing to Bartolomé takes about 2 hours.

Breakfast is served on board.

In the early hours, you may see dolphins and other marine animals near the yacht.

Once ashore, it’s about a 30-minute climb.

The trail crosses volcanic terrain to the highest point on the island.

From there, you can see Santiago, North Seymour, Baltra, Santa Cruz, Rábida, the islet of Chinese Hat and Pinnacle Rock.

After the walk, there’s time at the beach.

During the boat trip, you may spot Galápagos penguins.

They stand about 50 cm tall.

You might see them on the rocks by the water or darting through the clear sea.

Then there’s time to swim and snorkel.

You may spot penguins, reef sharks, starfish, rays, sea turtles and colourful fish.

Marine iguanas, sea lions and pelicans are also found here.

Lunch is served on board.

Return to Puerto Ayora towards evening.

Evening at leisure.

Stay at the 3-star Fiesta hotel.

Breakfast and lunch are included.
Two turquoise bays among the brown volcanic hills of the Galápagos Islands, Ecuador
Galápagos: bays and a rocky volcanic shore
Galápagos: North Seymour or South Plaza

The island is confirmed after booking.

Both options offer a comparable range of experiences.

**Option 1. North Seymour and Bachas**

Return to Puerto Ayora at around 16:00.

**Option 2. South Plaza and Punta Carrión**

After the walk, continue to Punta Carrión.

Lunch is served on board.

There’s time to swim and snorkel off the point.

You may see rays, reef sharks, Galápagos sharks and plenty of tropical fish.

After the excursion, return to the hotel.

Evening at leisure.

Stay at the 3-star Fiesta hotel.

Breakfast and lunch are included.
